title: SERVICENOW APP
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.REGIONAL MAINTENANCE CENTER.SOUTHWEST REGIONAL MAINT CENTER
detail_text: Southwest Regional Maintenance Center (SWRMC), Code 410A Procurement, intends to award a sole source requirement to Carahsoft Technology Corp. to provide ServiceNow Software. The requirement will be processed in accordance with FAR part 12. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 541519 - Other Computer Related Services. This notice is neither a request nor a solicitation of offers; however, all information received after date of publication of this synopsis will be reviewed by the Government for future considerations. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether conducting a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. Responses must provide clean and concise documentation indicating a vendor's bonafide capability to provide this product or equivalency. Requests must include company name, address, telephone number of the requester, e-mail address, Cage code, and business size. All information should be delivered via e-mail to Valerie.p.manguiob.civ@us.navy.mil and dayen.lagunas.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 11:00 AM (PST), 11 March 2026. Certifications in the System for Award Management must be current and active to be eligible for contract award.
